Subject: Quick recap + next steps (security intake + tech deep-dive)

John —

Thanks again for the intro call today. Quick recap from our side:
- Goals: evaluate Redwood for low-latency inference across multi-region fulfillment rules and sensitive PII handling.
- Primary success metrics: 95th percentile latency under 250ms for 2k QPS, tokens cost target ~ $0.0009/token for batch inference.
- Key stakeholders to involve: Security (Ben), Procurement (Priya), Platform/ops.

Recommended next steps:
1) 30–45m technical deep-dive (runtime, KV cache, data controls) with your platform/infra team.
2) Security intake: we can share our questionnaire and SOC 2 artifacts ahead of the call so Ben can validate.
3) Procurement intro to discuss pilot commercial terms and an NDA if needed.

Marissa (cc) will coordinate the technical demo owner and proposed times. Kar (cc) will be on the deep-dive from security/devrel side.

I attached our security questionnaire and a draft SOW for planning — feel free to share internally. Proposed slots (ET):
- Tuesday 2/24, 10:00–10:45
- Wednesday 2/25, 14:00–14:45
- Thursday 2/26, 09:00–09:45

If none of those work, let me know your range and we’ll align.

Best,
Alex Martinez

+1 415-555-0132
